name: Exp_SilverTrend_ColorJFatl_Digit_MMRec
summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on the SilverTrend signal filtered through a ColorJFatl (Jurate Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital indicator, combining trend direction detection with adaptive smoothing. It incorporates money management recommendations (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing and risk control. The EA opens positions when the SilverTrend signal aligns with the JFatl trend direction, providing a systematic trend-following approach with built-in capital preservation logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于SilverTrend信号并通过ColorJFatl数字指标进行过滤，结合趋势方向检测与自适应平滑技术进行交易。它内置了资金管理建议（MMRec）模块，用于动态仓位调整和风险控制。当SilverTrend信号与JFatl趋势方向一致时，EA开仓交易，提供了一种系统化的趋势跟踪方法并内置资金保护逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于SilverTrend指标的信号生成机制，SilverTrend是一种经典的趋势判断指标，通过识别价格突破动态支撑阻力线来产生买卖信号。ColorJFatl_Digit指标作为信号过滤器，利用Jurik自适应趋势线的平滑特性去除噪音信号，仅当两个指标方向一致时才触发交易。入场条件为SilverTrend发出趋势反转信号且JFatl方向确认，典型表现为趋势线颜色变化与信号线交叉的共振。出场条件包括反向信号出现、止损/止盈触发，以及资金管理模块的强制平仓机制。仓位管理采用MMRec模块，根据账户余额、风险比例和止损距离动态计算交易手数，实现固定百分比风险控制。资金管理方面，EA建议根据账户净值调整风险敞口，在连续亏损时可能减少仓位以保护资本，体现了保守的资金管理理念。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the SilverTrend indicator's signal generation mechanism, where SilverTrend is a classic trend determination indicator that identifies buy and sell signals by detecting price breakouts of dynamic support and resistance lines. The ColorJFatl_Digit indicator serves as a signal filter, utilizing the smoothing characteristics of the Jurik Adaptive Trend Line to remove noisy signals, only triggering trades when both indicators align in direction. Entry conditions require SilverTrend to issue a trend reversal signal confirmed by the JFatl direction, typically manifesting as a confluence of trend line color changes and signal line crossovers. Exit conditions include the appearance of reverse signals, stop-loss/take-profit triggers, and forced liquidation mechanisms from the money management module. Position sizing employs the MMRec module, which dynamically calculates trade lots based on account balance, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance, implementing a fixed-percentage risk control approach. In terms of money management, the EA recommends adjusting risk exposure based on account equity, potentially reducing position sizes during consecutive losses to protect capital, reflecting a conservative capital management philosophy.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理模式选择（0=固定手数，1=动态风险比例）
parameters.description_en: Money management mode (0=fixed lots, 1=dynamic risk ratio)

parameters.name: Risk
parameters.description: 每笔交易风险比例（账户余额的百分比）
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade (% of account balance)

parameters.name: Lot
parameters.description_en: Fixed trading lot size (effective when MM=0)

parameters.name: SL
parameters.description: 止损点数（0=使用指标计算）
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points (0=use indicator calculation)

parameters.name: TP
parameters.description: 止盈点数（0=使用指标计算）
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points (0=use indicator calculation)

parameters.name: JFatlLength
parameters.description: JFatl自适应趋势线周期长度

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号确认K线索引（1=前一根已收盘K线）

pros: 双指标过滤机制（SilverTrend+JFatl）减少虚假信号，提高交易胜率
内置MMRec资金管理模块支持动态仓位调整，有效控制单笔风险敞口
JFatl自适应平滑技术能根据市场波动自动调整灵敏度，适应不同行情
pros_en: Dual indicator filtering mechanism (SilverTrend + JFatl) reduces false signals and improves trade win rate
Built-in MMRec money management module supports dynamic position sizing, effectively controlling per-trade risk exposure
JFatl adaptive smoothing technology automatically adjusts sensitivity based on market volatility, adapting to different market conditions
cons: SilverTrend指标在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假反转信号，导致连续亏损
依赖两个自定义指标的正确编译和加载，指标文件缺失时EA将无法运行
缺乏显式的新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓
cons_en: SilverTrend indicator tends to generate frequent false reversal signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Depends on correct compilation and loading of two custom indicators; EA will fail to run if indicator files are missing
Lacks explicit new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加新K线检查逻辑，确保每个K线只开一次仓，避免重复信号导致的过度交易
添加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或ATR阈值），在低趋势强度时暂停交易以减少虚假信号损失
improvements_en: Add new bar check logic to ensure only one position per bar, avoiding over-trading from repeated signals
Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or ATR threshold) to pause trading during low trend strength periods, reducing losses from false signals

risk_points: 缺乏显式新K线检查可能导致同一K线上重复开仓，增加风险敞口
在震荡行情中SilverTrend信号可靠性下降，可能产生连续亏损
risk_points_en: Lack of explicit new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
SilverTrend signal reliability decreases in ranging markets, potentially generating consecutive losses
